arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'Italy'
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate over labelled transactions at merchant locations whose state field is Italy, along with the counts behind it.
assumptions: Italy is matched against merchant_locations.state, where non-US countries are stored, and no city filter is applied.
Only labelled transactions are counted; unlabelled ones are excluded from the denominator.
